q: What is the carbon footprint of a wood carving unit in Saharanpur?
title: Saharanpur wood carving: emissions
short: A carving unit's own emissions are mostly electricity for saws, lathes, sanders and spray guns, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Timber, polish and lacquer are bought-in Scope 3. Carbon stored in the wood is reported separately, not subtracted from your total.

ul: Scope 2: grid power for machines and lights.
Scope 1: diesel genset during cuts, if any.
Scope 3: timber, varnish, packaging and freight.

p: Wooden goods may also need deforestation-free proof under EUDR. That is a separate check from the carbon figure.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
